Course calendar

/courses/:courseId/calendar
Roles: student, instructor, taScope: requiredPriority: coreLegacy: S12, S03

Show one course's published classes, exams, office hours and coursework dates. Instructor-authored course events use explicit publication/cancellation; private appointments stay in W07.

Entry and return
Course Calendar navigationW07 course-event detailW14 meeting/office-hour linkW29 academic event link
Layout regions
Course calendar headerCourse/term, timezone, agenda/week/month and date navigation; Source filters: meetings, office hours, exams, assessment deadlines
Published event viewAcademic event title/type, exact date/time/location and source; Personal coursework date before course date; changed/cancelled markers
Event drawerCanonical event ID/version, recurrence and affected occurrence; Instructor event management; TA grading-deadline handoff distinct from learner dates

Keep eventCancel selected scope
Permissions
  • Private W07 event titles/details never enter W32.
  • TA can read allocated deadlines but cannot change policy, publish course events or release results.
  • Institution-managed meeting facts are read-only; instructor changes only owned course events.
Responsive
  • Narrow default is agenda with full type/source/date labels.
  • Editor becomes full-width; date selection has text-input alternatives.
Accessibility
  • Grid has equivalent keyboard/list path; event status conveyed with words.
  • Date validation links errors to start/end/zone; publication review names scope.
Data
  • Shared published event ID/version/source, recurrence/exception and cancellation.
  • Assessment canonical dates plus personal allowance; staff allocation references separate.
Acceptance checks (4)
  • Publishing one exam creates one shared event across W07/W32, never duplicate copies.
  • Editing one office-hour occurrence preserves the rest of the series.
  • Private owner events never appear in course calendar or instructor audience preview.
  • A failed publication leaves prior version and its reminders unchanged.
Notes
  • PROPOSED academic web route template for HTML-first handoff; legacy IDs show lineage, not replacement or changed acceptance.
